rows.text: At its meeting on 28 November 2005, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and monetary developments and left the central bank base rate unchanged at 6.00%.
The minutes of today’s Council meeting will be published at 2 p.m. on 9 December 2005.
The Council also set the dates for its meetings in 2006 (every second scheduled meeting is interest rate-setting meeting):

The dates of electronic publication of the Bank’s Quarterly Report on Inflation in 2006 are as follows: 2 p.m., Monday, 27 February 2006 (short version), 2 p.m., Monday, 22 May 2006, 2 p.m., Monday, 28 August 2006 (short version) and 2 p.m., Monday, 20 November 2006.
The Monetary Council will issue a statement on its assessment of economic conditions simultaneously with publication of the Report on Financial Stability will be published once a year from 2006.
